content: Standard pattern for hand-building a month calendar grid in React: CSS Grid with grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr), no nested per-row DOM needed. Use date-fns (startOfMonth/endOfMonth/startOfWeek/endOfWeek/eachDayOfInterval) to build the flat array of 35-42 day cells including leading/trailing days from adjacent months. Events are grouped by date key (format(date, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) into a Map, then rendered as badges/chips inside each cell; a '+N more' indicator is simple application logic: slice the day's events to a max (e.g. 3) and render a count of the remainder. No calendar/events library is required for this pattern -- it's plain array/date math plus CSS.
